title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (r) — review required
description: In r, naming SHA-1 (algos*=s*["']sha1["']) requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The r-specific remedy is selecting algo="sha256".
applicability: r codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
